By TARA ANSON-WALSH, FOOTBALL REPORTER.

Published: 07:48 EST, 13 November 2026 | Updated: 08:08 EST, 13 November 2026.

Michael Carrick has released his first public statement on his Manchester United sacking, calling the job an 'immense privilege' in a classy 411-word tribute to the club's supporters.

The statement, released a little over 24 hours after his dismissal was confirmed, read: 'Dear United Fans, I've had the immense privilege of leading Manchester United, the football club that I love.

'There are very few who get to live that and feel it, and for that I'm incredibly grateful.

Recent findings suggest that 'With that comes huge responsibility, and to be at Manchester United, you need to understand exactly what that means. It's different to anywhere else.

'Ultimately, you need to push to be the best, but there is a culture, there are values and there are behaviours that you have to live by and respect, which have been built over a long period of time.

Recent findings suggest that 'It's a football club that is unique, with substance and history that cannot be ignored. This is what inspired me every single day. I want to say a big thank you to the supporters. I must say, you are a special, rare breed.

Michael Carrick has broken his silence on his sacking by Manchester United.

Sources indicate that 'We've had some great times this year and moments we'll all remember. The best thing about being in my position was seeing so many of you lose yourselves in the emotion of those moments, leaving the stadium desperate to come back again next time.

Industry observers note that 'I just wanted to give you something back. That love never dies. I know we've not had the results lately, but you've shown me nothing but love and support in times when the easiest thing, and what most end up doing, would be to turn the other way.

Recent findings suggest that 'That means more than a win or two. That's what makes you who you are. That's why I fell in love with this club all those years ago.

'A special thank you to my coaching staff. You gave me everything you had, every single day, and I couldn't have asked for any more. I'm incredibly grateful for your loyalty, hard work and support throughout.

'To all the staff behind the scenes, thank you for everything you do for this football club. So much of your work goes unseen, but it never goes unappreciated.

It has been revealed that 'And to the players, thank you for your efforts and the moments we've shared. I wish you all the very best for what's ahead.

Sources indicate that 'I want nothing but success for Manchester United. This club has been such a substantial part of my life and that will never change. I'll always be proud to have played my part and I'll always want the very best for it.

'I'll be right there with you from now on, watching from the sidelines, cheering the lads on. Michael.'.

The statement follows his former team-mate Gary Neville suggesting that Carrick had grounds to sue United for their 'disgusting' treatment of the United legend.

Carrick was left in the lurch by the club's hierarchy - but continued to attend training on Tuesday and Wednesday – amid widespread reports that he would imminently be relieved of his duties.

The classy statement follows Carrick former team-mate Gary Neville suggesting that he had grounds to sue United for their 'disgusting' treatment of his dismissal.

Neville told Sky Sports News: 'In the last 24-48 hours it's been spectacularly bad to be in Monaco as an executive and an owner whilst your manager, who's a club legend, is taking training on the pitch and simultaneously approaching the US Soccer Federation to approach Mauricio Pochettino.

'It's just quite simply disgusting. That falls well below the standard of what you would expect in any other business, in any other industry. It would be constructive dismissal and you'd be getting sued.

'The optics of being in Monaco whilst the team, the staff, the people who are running the club on a day-to-day basis are in Manchester, it's just not good and it reflects badly on the leadership.

'I don't think anybody comes out of this well at all.'.

Less than an hour prior to Carrick's statement United confirmed his replacement, Pochettino, will take the reins after agreeing a two-and-a-half-year contract at Old Trafford.

United have agreed to pay more than £10million to buy Pochettino and his backroom staff out of their contracts with the US Soccer Federation.

The 54-year-old Argentine will take charge of the US’s CONCACAF Nations League double-header against Haiti in Miami on Saturday and Cincinnati on Wednesday before beginning his new job as United boss on Wednesday.

His first game will be against Liverpool at Anfield a week on Sunday.

Pochettino is due to give a pre-match press conference at 2.15pm on Friday but is not expected to speak about United until he arrives next week due to his remaining contracted to US Soccer.

United have agreed to pay more than £10million to buy Pochettino and his backroom staff out of their contracts with the US Soccer Federation.

A statement from the club read: ‘Mauricio Pochettino has agreed to become the Manchester United men’s head coach from 18 November.

‘The club has reached an agreement with the US Soccer Federation for Mauricio and his staff to be released after the conclusion of their responsibilities with the US men’s national team.

‘The Argentinian is renowned for his high-intensity, attacking style of football, his dedication to building strong, cohesive teams and his outstanding record of developing individual players.

Industry observers note that ‘Pochettino has consistently performed at the highest level of football across multiple leagues. He began his coaching career with Espanyol in 2009 before joining Southampton and achieving a club-record Premier League points tally in 2014.

‘During five full seasons at Tottenham Hotspur, Pochettino established the club as regular UEFA Champions League contenders, securing qualification in four consecutive seasons and leading the club to its first final in the competition in 2019.

Industry observers note that ‘In 2021, he joined Paris Saint-Germain, where he won the Ligue 1 title, the Coupe de France and the Trophée des Champions before joining Chelsea in 2023. Most recently he led the U.S. Men’s National Team to the Round of 16 at the FIFA World Cup.’.

According to recent reports, A tre giorni dalla scadenza per la presentazione della candidatura alla presidenza della FIFA, l'UEFA ha sciolto la riserva sul suo candidato che sfiderà Infantino. Nelle ultime ore si è parlato anche di una probabile candidatura di Luis Figo, promosso anche da diversi funzionari dell'UEFA. Ebbene, l'UEFA, con un comunicato ufficiale, ha scelto un altro profilo:.

"Nel corso di una riunione tenutasi oggi e presieduta dal presidente della UEFA Aleksander Čeferin, le federazioni nazionali rappresentate nel Comitato Esecutivo della UEFA e nel Consiglio FIFA hanno invitato Philippe Diallo, presidente della Federazione calcistica francese (FFF), a candidarsi alle elezioni presidenziali della FIFA nel marzo 2027 e hanno unanimemente promesso il loro pieno sostegno.

"Philippe Diallo vanta una vasta esperienza a tutti i livelli del calcio, avendo guidato l'organizzazione che rappresenta i club calcistici professionistici francesi, fatto parte del consiglio di amministrazione della lega professionistica francese e delle strutture di risoluzione delle controversie della FIFA, prima di diventare presidente della FFF e membro del Comitato Esecutivo della UEFA nel 2023.

Nel contesto delle serie preoccupazioni relative alla direzione intrapresa dalla FIFA, le federazioni nazionali hanno auspicato una rinnovata unità e fiducia all'interno della comunità calcistica globale. Hanno inoltre chiesto una FIFA che ponga lo sviluppo del calcio in ogni regione del mondo al centro della propria missione, che sostenga i più alti standard di governance e che lavori in stretta collaborazione con le federazioni affiliate, le confederazioni e tutti gli attori del mondo del calcio. Hanno espresso piena fiducia in Philippe Diallo, ritenendolo la leader necessaria per raggiungere questo obiettivo. Philippe Diallo ha accettato l'invito a candidarsi. La sua candidatura sarà formalmente ratificata dal Comitato Esecutivo della FFF nella riunione di domani".

Dolores Aveiro contesta l’omaggio organizzato in assenza del figlio dopo la gara di Nations League contro la Danimarca.

Dolores Aveiro critica l’omaggio del Portogallo a Cristiano Ronaldo: secondo la madre dell’attaccante, la nazionale avrebbe dovuto celebrarlo in sua presenza e non gli avrebbe riservato il rispetto meritato. Secondo quanto riportato da SportMediaset, Le sue parole riaprono il dibattito sull’addio del figlio alla selezione, dopo il tributo organizzato in occasione della partita di Nations League contro la Danimarca. SportMediaset riporta lo sfogo raccolto dai media portoghesi.

CLICCA QUI E SEGUI LAZIOPRESS.IT ANCHE SU INSTAGRAM.

Industry observers note that la madre di Ronaldo lega la propria amarezza anche alla sconfitta della squadra: «Lo hanno tradito, e per questo sono stata contenta della sconfitta del Portogallo». Parlando dello stato d’animo dell’attaccante dell’Al-Nassr, aggiunge: «Cristiano ci è rimasto male, è stato ingannato e anch'io provo molta amarezza. Il ko della nazionale? Ben gli sta, ne sono stata felice».

Al centro delle sue critiche c’è soprattutto il modo in cui la Federazione ha scelto di rendere omaggio al giocatore. «Un tributo del genere andava organizzato in sua presenza, non mentre era assente. In nazionale non ha ricevuto il rispetto che meritava, nemmeno da parte dei suoi stessi compagni», afferma Aveiro.

It has been revealed that dolores Aveiro parla a margine di un evento ufficiale allo stadio José Alvalade di Lisbona, casa dello Sporting, il club in cui Ronaldo è cresciuto. È lì che, a suo giudizio, il figlio riceverà il riconoscimento più sentito: «Il vero riconoscimento lo riceverà qui allo Sporting, dove sanno dargli il giusto valore, al contrario di quanto fatto dalla Federazione».

Durante l’ultimo incontro di campionato tra Sporting e Moreirense, il pubblico aveva già dedicato un omaggio all’ex giocatore. Al settimo minuto lo stadio si era alzato in piedi, tra striscioni e l’urlo siuuu. Sui maxischermi erano state proiettate alcune delle sue giocate più note, per celebrare la carriera internazionale appena conclusa.

Anche la nazionale aveva preparato un tributo prima della gara con la Danimarca, la prima dopo l’addio di Ronaldo e terminata 1-4 per la squadra di Jorge Jesus. Gli undici titolari erano entrati in campo indossando tutti la maglia numero 7. Al settimo minuto il pubblico aveva applaudito, mentre sui led a bordo campo compariva il messaggio «Obrigado, Capi7ao», con il numero 7 al posto della lettera T.

💡 Key Takeaways

  • There are few sights more incendiary to the modern manager than a footballer reaching for his phone as soon as he walks through the dressing room door.
  • But the Everton and Republic of Ireland defender had a good excuse: he’s the only Type One diabetic playing in the Premier League.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Published: 21:00 EST, 12 November 2026 | Updated: 08:25 EST, 13 November 2026.

There are few sights more incendiary to the modern manager than a footballer reaching for his phone as soon as he walks through the dressing room door. So you can imagine the reaction Jake O’Brien received when he pulled out his mobile just before one half-time team talk.

But the Everton and Republic of Ireland defender had a good excuse: he’s the only Type One diabetic playing in the Premier League.

O’Brien’s body is unable to create insulin, the hormone that regulates the amount of glucose in your blood.

Loaded on his mobile is an app linked via Bluetooth to a circular device on his arm which gives a reading of his blood sugar levels. It is then that he takes out a needle and injects the necessary insulin dose into his thigh or stomach.

‘There was one guy who didn’t react too well. Mentioning no names! He was saying: "What are you doing on your phone?"' O’Brien recalls. ‘But he soon realised what it was for.’.

It can also come as a shock to the uninitiated among his team-mates.

‘One or two are taken aback at first,’ he notes. ‘It can be a bit confusing. “What’s he doing?’’ Or maybe those that are a little squeamish, but they soon get used to it. It's only a small needle.'.

Everton and Ireland defender Jake O'Brien is the only diabetic footballer in the Premier League.

O'Brien (pictured attending an awareness workshop put on by Everton) revels in the role of being a diabetes ambassador.

O'Brien (pictured with his partner Sophie) indicates some of his team-mates are 'taken aback' when he injects himself with insulin (Source: Instagram/Obrienjake_).

Tracking blood glucose levels is now an everyday part of O'Brien's life but it is a life that was unwittingly put in jeopardy prior to his diagnosis at 16.

O’Brien was later told he had been just one day away from slipping into a coma when his concerned parents ushered him to the doctors near the family home in Youghal, County Cork, for a check-up.

Recent findings suggest that their sports-mad son, who had won national titles at boxing and hurling, was tired, losing weight and had an insatiable thirst despite drinking eight to nine litres of water a day. He had lost seven kilograms in just over a week. A blood test revealed his blood sugar was ten times what was considered stable and he was rushed to hospital.

In a recent development, ‘I was told I was a day away from a coma,' indicates O'Brien. 'If I had gone to sleep that night without having gone to the doctor, who knows?’.

Sources indicate that he went into hospital that night weighing 53kg, or just over eight stone. Two weeks post-diagnosis he was back up to 60kg, and within two years he had put on a whopping 30kg.

'Yeah, 30kg,' laughs O'Brien. 'I know it's not normal. It must have been some grocery bill for Mum, but I was motivated to put on the weight, going to the gym all the time.

In a recent development, ‘I was a bit naive about it all,' he deadpans. ‘I never expected to have anything but once I knew what diabetes was, I didn’t wallow in it, I took it as a positive. Everything just clicked for me physically. I just thought, "Right, now I know what’s wrong, I can get on with my life again".

‘It was a pain going in and out of hospital, but I just took it as education and wanted to get my sport back on track.

'My family are... I wouldn't say cold, but matter of fact. Supportive, obviously, but they are all sporty too, so it was just, "Get on with it".'.

O'Brien's life in the Premier League would have seemed inconceivable when he fell down to 53kg as a teenager and was hospitalised.

He is now an imposing 6ft 6in tall, weighing around 96kg. His physique offers no outward indication of the daily challenge he is dealing with.

Sources indicate that today, relaxing in the cafe at Everton’s Finch Farm training complex, O’Brien is an imposing 6ft 6in tall, weighing around 96kg. His physique offers no outward indication of the daily challenge he is dealing with.

Sources indicate that there’s a Cork-lilt to his softly spoken Irish tone. He’s polite and engaging and it’s clear he revels in the role of being a diabetes ambassador, spreading the message that diagnosis doesn’t have to end your dreams.

Such has been his impact, he has even attracted support from fans of the other club in the city.

One, six-year-old Liverpool fan Louis, reached out via Instagram to ask O’Brien how he kept up his glucose levels during a game and whether he suffered any ‘hypos’ - the expression for hypoglycemic episodes, when the blood sugar drops too low and leaves you faint or dizzy.

It has been revealed that louis, whose siblings Paisley and Evie also have Type One diabetes, followed up by challenging O’Brien to a penalty shootout. If the Everton man lost, he faced a forfeit, he would have to shout ‘Up the Reds’ on social media.

‘You play for the wrong team but you're still a Type One hero, and Mum indicates you're proof that diabetes doesn't stop you from playing at the top level,’ posted Louis.

Touched by the message, O’Brien asked Everton to invite the youngster and his family to training for a kickabout, although ultimately, we are assured they reached a compromise on the penalties forfeit.

‘I’ve struck up a rapport with some kids and groups here and in Ireland,' indicates O'Brien. 'They often have the same story as mine of not being sure what the future holds.

‘There’s a big misconception about diabetes over what it is and the limitations it brings.

‘Just because you have diabetes doesn’t mean your dreams are over.’.

Sources indicate that ‘Adrenaline is higher on match days so that can change how you feel. I may inject four times before a night game and a bit more at half-time'.

‘Just because you have diabetes doesn’t mean your dreams are over,’ says O'Brien, who also excelled at boxing and hurling as a boy (Source: TikTok/Everton).

The centre back credits boxing for helping discipline with his diet but underlines ‘no food is off limits, it’s just about applying common sense'.

Recent findings suggest that A typical day sees him eat eggs, salmon and dates for breakfast to match his insulin doses to the carbohydrates he’s taking on around 9.30am before training. Afterwards he’ll have a light lunch at 2pm then take something back from the training ground for a light evening meal.

‘I just have to watch carbohydrates. I’ll eat more of them on match day but then work out my insulin ratio to the amount I eat and whether I need to inject more.

In a recent development, ‘Adrenaline is higher on match days so that can change how you feel, I may inject four times before a night game and inject a bit more at half-time. If it’s not quite right you may get a bit heavy-legged or if I get a few cramps I may need a gel. But I've had no dangerous episodes.'.

When World Diabetes Day dawns on Saturday, O’Brien will be fully focused on preparing to play for Ireland in Austria in the Nations League.

It will give him a chance to revert to his favoured centre back position having been asked to fill in predominantly at right back under David Moyes.

He acknowledges it's not his preferred role but dismisses rumours that he wanted to leave as a result in the summer.

Industry observers note that 'There was nothing in that,' O'Brien affirms. ‘I was never close to leaving.

Industry observers note that 'People know I'm not a natural right back but I'll play wherever I need to, to help the team. We're only a small squad so it’s notable everyone chips in.

‘There’s a lot of different right backs. I see Arsenal have centre backs playing at right back so I can take pointers from them but then again, I am 6ft 6in so I’m not the average shape.’.

O'Brien insists there was 'nothing in' reports that he wanted to leave Everton last summer to get more minutes at his preferred position of centre back.

At least O’Brien has former Everton captain Seamus Coleman on hand for advice.

Sources indicate that ‘Seamus is a good friend. He still gives me pointers of where to be, positioning wise and seeing the game differently.'.

Sources indicate that ireland assistant John O'Shea, a versatile defender himself in his Manchester United days, is another mentor. O’Shea and Ireland boss Heimir Hallgrímsson were at Hill Dickinson Stadium to watch O'Brien play his part in Everton's recent Carabao Cup win over Newcastle.

'Heimir is a good guy,' says O'Brien. 'Very understanding. It's always a nice change of scenery to link up with Ireland. We've got a difficult couple of games (Austria and Kosovo) but hopefully if we get two wins it’s within reach.'.

Indeed, if there's a mantra that personifies O'Brien's outlook on life, no matter what knocks you take, it is: always believe you can still achieve.

'Don’t be afraid and don’t let anything hold you back, that's what I say.'.

Sources indicate that anche a te è venuta voglia di tornare in campo? "No, no, a me no. Io poi gioco in un altro ruolo, per un portiere è più difficile. Ronaldinho può stare anche fermo in campo che la gente applaude, io dovrei parare, quindi sarebbe più difficile".

Sources indicate that maignan si è fatto male con la Francia. Magari potrebbe servire un portiere... "Ma no, abbiamo già un ragazzo come Torriani che sta facendo bene. 📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Thomas Tuchel has never been inclined to place much faith in the most famous right-back at his disposal, Trent Alexander-Arnold, once of Liverpool, now of Real Madrid, and – back in an England shirt – still capable of changing games in the blink of an eye.

Recent findings suggest that england always looked likely to defeat a beleaguered Czech Republic team down to 10 men with just 25 minutes played, but it still required one man to conjure the moment of inspiration in this Nations League tie. This was the first cap in 15 months for the right-back now known simply as “Trent” in an England shirt – as well as his Real Madrid jersey – rather than the six syllables of his surname. With the game level at half-time, two minutes into the upcoming half, he twice won the ball before landing a cross on the head of Anthony Gordon for the first goal.

TRENT ➡️ GORDON ⚽️🔥Anthony Gordon can't stop scoring for England, 3 goals in his last 3 games for England 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁥󠁮󠁧󠁿#ITVFootball | @England pic.twitter.com/xmqPIULJ24.

Will the Alexander-Arnold with England experiment survive? One feels that Tuchel will need a little more to convince him to abandon whatever reservations he has about the Liverpudlian. A week short of his 28th birthday, Alexander-Arnold was winning just his 35th cap. His Real Madrid team-mate Jude Bellingham, a second-half substitute, was earning his 58th cap less than two months after his 23rd birthday. Bellingham was on as captain in place of the man he replaced, Harry Kane, scorer of England’s second. Bellingham’s international career has taken a much less rocky path than that of his Real team-mate.

Having missed the World Cup finals this summer, and had little good fortune around previous tournaments, one wonders if Euro 2028 might be the watershed moment for Alexander-Arnold. Either way, against opponents who sit back, he is lethal when it is time for the big delivery. Alexander-Arnold may not have the breadth of England experience that some of his peers have accumulated, but he does have plenty of experience of big games.

It has been revealed that “I make that run time and time again,” Gordon noted of his anticipation of the Alexander-Arnold cross, “but only a set number of players have that ability, that technique and the bravery to risk a mistake to play that pass. And that’s why I have been dying to play with him [Alexander-Arnold]. He’s been on his own journey but has trained really well this week. He should have played more. Sorry – he would have loved to have played more.”.

A Freudian slip from the Barcelona winger, another Liverpudlian in Spain, who himself has barely put a foot wrong for England of late. He has three goals in three games for England, including the World Cup semi-final against Argentina. This was an England team that Tuchel fine-tuned, first to give a rest to Bellingham and in other quarters, too. Lewis Hall started at left-back. Trevoh Chalobah won his third England cap at centre-back. Alex Scott, of Bournemouth, was given his debut off the bench in the second half and Rio Ngumoha won the second cap of his England career, just one month after his 18th birthday.

As for Kane, his 87th goal for England now puts him within two goals of Robert Lewandowski, among four greats in the seven ahead of Kane on the all-time international goalscorers’ list. By the end of this international break the England captain should have equalled Peter Shilton’s record 125 caps. It has been an astonishing career even if it ends tomorrow. Following the missed penalty against Spain, Kane was again the man in the right place at the right time when Morgan Rogers’s shot was blocked in the second half.

“Strange to get an early red card,” Tuchel noted. “Not the best for the team and spectators. It’s an awkward one, but we kept going, got a win and that’s what counts.” Not quite a vintage Czech Republic team, either, and when their best player of the opening stages, the attacking midfielder Pavel Sulc, of Lyon in Ligue 1, was dismissed after 25 minutes, it certainly did not become any easier for the home team. Sulc, the Czech player of the year in 2025, had mistimed a tackle on Elliot Anderson, which on a VAR review, the Turkish referee Umut Meler decided was worthy of an upgrade from yellow to red. It was high on the right calf of the England midfielder.

Czech Republic DOWN TO 10 MEN! 🟥Pavel Šulc sees red for a dangerous challenge on Elliot Anderson#ITVFootball | @England pic.twitter.com/B2YOLuS0vL.

England had looked once more a little open to the counter-attack in the early stages, with Sulc one notable runner. This was not an opponent of the quality of Spain and Tuchel’s players were able to recover the situation. When they lose the ball in the opposition’s half, England tend to look vulnerable.

Even before the red card Rogers had hit a post. Myles Lewis-Skelly, playing in midfield, was booked for a foul on Lukas Serv and was pursued thereafter by the Czech players hoping to get an upgrade on the yellow card. He was substituted at half-time, with Eberechi Eze on in his place.

It has been revealed that “I spoke to Ant [Gordon] at half-time,” Alexander-Arnold mentioned later to ITV, “and I said if I’m getting in those spaces make sure you get to the back post. You don’t expect to get it that fast, but it did and it worked.”.

Recent findings suggest that two minutes after the break, Alexander-Arnold suddenly burst into life. He won the ball back in his own area and then drove forward in search of the return. When that did not come, he raced back to win the ball again and unleashed one of those right-footed outswingers to the back post, where Gordon guided in the header. “Really proud to score that,” Gordon noted, “because I can’t tell you the number of hours I’ve spent practising headers.”.

Sources indicate that kane scored the second just a minute before he was replaced and Bellingham took the captain’s armband and the role as a No 9. One day someone will have to step into those goalscorer’s boots on a permanent basis and try to replace Kane – although it may be a while yet.

Thomas Tuchel has backed Jude Bellingham as a future England captain after giving him the armband in the victory over the Czech Republic.

In the absence of Declan Rice, who was vice-captain at the World Cup, Bellingham assumed the role when he came on for Harry Kane, who is now in his 10th season as England captain and also scored in the 2-0 win in Prague.

Tuchel, who needs to check on Bellingham ahead of Saturday’s game against Croatia after a “niggle,” has praised the midfielder’s attitude during the extended international break one year after he was back from an injury but left out of the squad.

According to recent reports, “If you are the captain at the end of these matches, you can be the permanent captain,” Tuchel noted when asked whether Bellingham could eventually lead the team. “He was the captain against Upcoming Zealand before the World Cup. It is always a reward and always an honour.

Industry observers note that “I think he loves to be with us at the moment. That’s what I feel, and we had this small talk today about his role. We felt in our hearts or our stomachs to say ‘let’s go again, let’s start again’ and also our heads told us maybe 30 minutes is enough for this match because he hasn’t played in this quick turnaround through this season. He has done it before, but not in the season, so we didn’t want to be the first ones to try that.

Sources indicate that “But even in this little encounter, you can see that he’s confident and happy to help from the bench. So it’s a reward. It’s good. He had a little niggle at the end of the match, so hopefully it’s nothing serious, and he’s available for Croatia.”.

Nico O’Reilly is a doubt for the Croatia match in Rijeka and there are also concerns over Ezri Konsa, who was on the bench but not fit enough to play.

In a recent development, trent Alexander-Arnold provided an assist for Anthony Gordon in the Real Madrid full-back’s first cap in 15 months. Gordon, meanwhile, has now scored in the first two Nations League games of the campaign and is staking his case to be an indispensable player for Tuchel.

Sources indicate that “He’s getting there. He’s defending his shirt, he’s defending his position, an excellent performance again after his performance against Spain,” Tuchel said.

“He was very decisive today and had an excellent goal. It was very, very difficult, but the technique and finishing was excellent. He scored against Spain, so he has decisive actions and he’s defending his shirt and his position. He does it on the highest level and he’s a very important player.”.

England returned to winning ways with a 2-0 win over Czech Republic in Prague.

Pavel Sulc’s first-half red card after a VAR review of his clumsy challenge on Elliot Anderson took the sting out of the initially lively hosts and Anthony Gordon gave Thomas Tuchel’s men a deserved lead early in the second half.

The forward headed home a fantastic cross by Trent Alexander-Arnold, who was making his first start under the German coach, before skipper Harry Kane scored to settle any nerves.

Perfectly competent and signs of promise in the left-back/left-wing axis. England looked too open against 11 men and better teams – hola España – may have capitalised on the sloppiness. Intervenuto ai microfoni di Sky Sport, Adriano Galliani ha commentato la sua decisione di non presentare ricorso contro l'ammissione della candidatura di Giovanni Malagò alla presidenza della FIGC:.

According to recent reports, "Malagò l'ha definito un gesto di signorilità? Continuo ad essere convinto che non si possa dare un voto due volte, se si può farlo allora qualunque candidatura può essere tolta all'ultimo minuto e all'improvviso con una revoca cade la candidatura. Faccio calcio da 50 anni, ho pensato che il nostro mondo ha bisogno di serenità e tranquillità, abbiamo tanti problemi, ho pensato di non fare niente e andiamo al 14 dicembre, si vota tra 4 settimane, ci sono due candidati e vedremo cosa succederà".

Cosa l'ha convinta a candidarmi?

In a recent development, "Avevo detto di no in precedenza, mi hanno convinto oltre le telefonate di qualche club anche quelle dell'Associazione Calciatori e Allenatori. Ulivieri, che c'era già quando ero presidente di Lega Calcio, mi ha detto che i rapporti migliori con la Lega Calcio c'erano quando ero presidente di Lega, la stessa cosa mi ha detto Umberto Calcagno che il suo maestro, l'avvocato Campana gli aveva riferito la stessa cosa e così mi hanno convinto. Il mio programma è molto lungo, l'ho presentato e depositato, è troppo lungo, dovrei parlare troppo tempo".

Harry Kane had to compose himself and hold back the tears while reading beautiful letters from his children after breaking the England appearance record.

The 33-year-old earned his 126th cap and scored in the 2-1 win over Croatia on Thursday night, with the Wembley crowd celebrating his achievement and Ballon d'Or triumph.

And on the following morning, there was a surprise in store for the England skipper, who was visibly taken aback on camera when presented with letters from his four children, nine-year-old Ivy, eight-year-old Vivi, five-year-old Louis and three-year-old Henry, who he shares with wife Kate.

It has been revealed that 'Wow, that’s uh a bit of a surprise,' Kane remarked as he examined the letters and artwork. 'I think you guys are trying to make me cry on camera.'.

He opened the first one before reading aloud: 'To Daddy, I love you very much and I want you to know that I’m very proud of you and also you are the best footballer in the world, the most kind Daddy in the world and the best striker in the world.

'I would like to celebrate you playing the most games for England by holiday together and eating ice cream.

Harry Kane was on the verge of tears as he read touching letters from his four children.

'My favorite thing about you is you never give up and I love all things you do for us. Love Ivy.'.

Sources indicate that dewy-eyed Kane then reflected: 'I wasn’t expecting this beautiful letter. Thank you Ivy. I love you. I've got one here from Vivian as well.'.

'Dear Daddy, I’m so happy and proud of you. I love you because you are hard working and make the best fried eggs. I want to celebrate with you by going fishing, going down the water slides and having a cinema trip as well. Love from Vivi.'.

According to recent reports, kane then remarked: 'Yeah, you’ve caught me by surprise here to be honest with you. I’m trying to just uh, stay strong for the camera. Thank you Vivi, love you.'.

Then came the letters from Kane's two sons, Louis and Henry.

Louis' read: 'To Daddy, I love you so much because you train and work so hard. My favorite thing we do together is play football and cricket together. I love when you play England football because you score goals and we get to sing Vindaloo. I want to celebrate with you by making an ice cream house with sweets inside. Love Louis.'.

Recent findings suggest that 'Thank you Louie, love you, boy. This last one is from Henry,' Kane stated.

The short and sweet note from his youngest went: 'Daddy, you are the winner. Vindaloo! Love Henry.'.

Kane walked onto the pitch with his children, (L-R) Henry, Ivy, Vivi, Louis on Thursday night.

Kane highlighted the artwork and hand-written letters to the camera as he read them.

Recent findings suggest that kane then pointed the endearing scribble to the camera, saying: 'He’s drawn me a lovely picture there. Love you, Henry. Thank you, beautiful messages from my wonderful family.'.

Kane, who lives with his family in Bavaria and recently signed a fresh deal worth £400,000-a-week at Bayern Munich, brought the whole clan, including his parents, to Wembley for his big night on Thursday.

He walked out onto the hallowed turf with his four children, admired a gigantic tifo of himself in the crowd, posed for pictures with the gleaming Ballon d'Or trophy and was given a commemorative shirt by Prince William.

Kane is a devoted family man in addition to being the world's best footballer and took a moment to say a few words about his children at the Ballon d'Or ceremony last month.

It has been revealed that he stated: 'To Ivy, Vivienne, Louis and Henry. You're the reason I do this.

Prince William presented Kane with a commemorative framed shirt with 126 on the back.

In a recent development, 'I don't think you'll fully maybe appreciate bringing this trophy home. I'll bring a few others home, but this one is a special one, so I can't wait to see you and celebrate with you.

'I want to set a good example being a father but also being a professional and what it means to work hard, what it means to believe in yourself. I love you very much.'.

Kane passed Peter Shilton as the record appearance-maker for England on Thursday and took his tally of goals for the national team to 92.

His penalty put England 2-1 up and they would not relinquish their lead. He'll next be in action against Spain on Sunday.

  • Industry observers note that E’ stato reso noto il bilancio annuale del Napoli.

Industry observers note that E’ stato reso noto il bilancio annuale del Napoli. Il documento svela le cifre del mercato estivo 2026 degli azzurri. la società partenopea ha illustrato le principali movimentazioni economiche legate alle acquisizioni e alle cessioni dei diritti alle prestazioni sportive dei calciatori. Nel dettaglio, il club di Aurelio De Laurentiis ha comunicato di aver realizzato plusvalenze complessive pari a 25,9 milioni di euro attraverso operazioni di cessione a titolo definitivo concluse dopo il 30 giugno 2026. A queste si aggiungono ulteriori 1,5 milioni di euro derivanti dalle cessioni a titolo temporaneo, confermando il contributo delle operazioni in uscita anche nella prima parte del nuovo esercizio contabile. Sul fronte degli acquisti, invece, il Napoli ha comunicato di aver effettuato investimenti per 10,7 milioni di euro relativamente alleacquisizioni a titolo definitivo dei diritti alle prestazioni sportive dei calciatori. Tra gli acquisti, figurano Benoit Badiashile dal Chelsea in prestito con diritto di riscatto e Costantino Favasuli dal Catanzaro in prestito con obbligo di riscatto. Dal Sion è arrivato invece a titolo definitivo Dinis Rodrigues. Particolarmente importanti i riscatti di Rasmus Højlund dal Manchester United per 44 milioni di euro, Alisson Santos dallo Sporting Lisbona per 16,5 milioni e Vanja Milinkovic-Savic dal Torino per 6,5 milioni. Sono rimasti in azzurro, dopo le rispettive esperienze in prestito, anche Noa Lang, Lorenzo Lucca, Luca Marianucci, Rafa Marín e Jens Cajuste, sulla base delle operazioni riportate nei prospetti. In uscita, il Napoli ha ceduto Miguel Gutierrez al Bayern Leverkusen. La sua cessione risulta quella economicamente più rilevante. Romelu Lukaku si è trasferito al Fenerbahce. Hanno salutato Napoli anche Juan Jesus, svincolato, Eljif Elmas, rientrato al Lipsia, e Pasquale Mazzocchi, passato al Venezia in prestito con obbligo di riscatto condizionato. Walid Cheddira si è trasferito all’Avellino, mentre Luis Hasa al Frosinone, AlessioZerbin al Frosinone e Coli Saco al Riga FC. Il Torino e l’Udinese hanno inoltre riscattato rispettivamente Giovanni Simeone e Alessandro Zanoli. Numerosi i prestiti: Michael Folorunsho e Cyril Ngonge al Monza, Jesper Lindstrøm al Salisburgo, Nosa Edward Obaretin al Lorient, Emanuele Rao al Pisa e Giuseppe Ambrosino al Modena. La società azzurra ha inoltre sostenuto costi per ulteriori 3 milioni di euro per acquisizioni a titolo temporaneo. Complessivamente, dunque, gli investimenti comunicati dal club partenopeo per le operazioni in entrata successive alla chiusura dell’esercizio ammontano a 13,7 milioni di euro. Le informazioni contenute nel documento contabile non riportano, in questa specifica sezione, i nominativi dei calciatori coinvolti nelle singole trattative, limitandosi a fornire un quadro generale delle operazioni perfezionate dopo il 30 giugno. È importante sottolineare come i 25,9 milioni di euro di plusvalenze non corrispondano necessariamente agli incassi complessivi derivanti dalle cessioni. Le plusvalenze rappresentano infatti la differenza tra il corrispettivo riconosciuto per il trasferimento e il valore netto contabile residuo del diritto alle prestazioni sportive del calciatore. Si tratta, in ogni caso, di indicazioni significative in vista del prossimo bilancio del club partenopeo, relativo all’esercizio 2026/2027, sul quale ricadranno gli effetti economici di queste operazioni di calciomercato.

Una delle piste di calciomercato più interessanti per il Milan è quella che porta a Endrick del Real Madrid. Un nome caldo e in agenda per i rossoneri, che possono contare sugli ottimi rapporti con Roc Nation, la società di rappresentanza che cura la procura dell’attaccante brasiliano, che non ha mai chiuso le porte al Milan. Anzi. L’operazione, per il mercato di gennaio, sarebbe clamorosa anche perché i rossoneri sarebbero propensi all’acquisto in forma definitiva del giocatore e non andare con un prestito con obbligo di riscatto. Endrick è un giocatore che viene considerato ampiamente in linea con il disegno di rafforzamento tecnico del Milan che verrà fatto nelle prossime due sessioni di calciomercato e sarà sicuramente una pista da seguire.

Florentino Perez, presidente del Real Madrid, non ha mai chiuso alla possibilità di trattare con un club per la cessione di Endrick. Di certo i costi saranno importanti, ma Gerry Cardinale ha già dimostrato di non avere problemi ad aprire i cordoni della borsa per prendere calciatori che possano essere “da Milan”. I due si sono conosciuti di persona due anni fa, in occasione di Real Madrid-M ilan, quando Cardinale – in gran segreto – incontrò Perez presso il centro sportivo di Valdebebas in compagnia dell’allora amministratore delegato Giorgio Furlani (notizia che vi raccontammo in esclusiva). Successivamente seguì dal Royal Box del Bernabeu la vittoria per 1-3 dei rossoneri allenati da Paulo Fonseca grazie ai gol di Malick Thiaw, Alvaro Morata e Tijjani Reijnders.

Industry observers note that L’interessamento concreto per Endrick va in parallelo a quello per Nicolò Tresoldi del Club Brugge, ma è la testimonianza di come la proprietà rossonera abbia intenzione di puntare a profili di alto livello per velocizzare il processo di crescita. Per la difesa, invece, rimane vivo il nome di Gonçalo Inacio dello Sporting Lisbona.

According to recent reports, "La media gol, i progressi costanti che si vedono. Va tenuto conto anche del fatto che il centravanti è un ruolo particolare: le ali, i trequartisti, altri giocatori leggeri, si capisce subito, a 19-20 anni, quanto sono grandi, se sono in grado di giocare e se possono fare la differenza. Con i centravanti, nella storia del calcio, siamo abituati al fatto che maturino di solito verso i 25 anni, Toni ad esempio addirittura a 27-28 anni. Il fatto che Pio Esposito sia già così forte a 21 anni, perché di questo si tratta, ci fa pensare che possa diventare ancora più grande. Per diventare ancora più grande bisogna giocare ancora più partite, il fatto è che non bastano gli allenamenti. 📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Published: 09:58 EST, 13 November 2026 | Updated: 11:57 EST, 13 November 2026.

Usman Nurmagomedov and his entourage have been swiftly punished with prison sentences and fines in Abu Dhabi after their shocking hotel attack.

Nurmagomedov set upon UFC star Merab Dvalishvili on Wednesday, slapping him in the lobby of Yas Hilton hotel in a revenge mission filmed by his friends.

In a recent development, the Georgian-American Dvalishvili then retaliated and fought back with his cameraman as the melee rapidly descended into complete mayhem. Dvalishvili was left bloodied and bruised and the attackers were quickly detained by the authorities.

In just two days, their punishments have been decided by the Abu Dhabi Judicial Department, who published the findings on social media.

Recent findings suggest that six of the attackers were given six-month prison sentences and ordered to pay £61,000 each in fines. They will also be immediately deported  when their sentences end.

They were described as having 'caused panic, disturbed public security and  endangered lives'.

Two of Nurmagomedov's associates were fined £10,000 each for 'disturbing public security and assaulting others'.

Usman Nurmagomedov (left) was the one who initiated the brawl by slapping Merab Dvalishvili - his brother Umar (right) lost a title shot against the Georgian last year.

The Abu Dhabi court shared this post online confirming the punishments for the attackers.

And the other two members of the group who recorded the assault were given six-month sentences, £61,000 fines and confiscation of the devices used.

They were punished 'for violating privacy by using information technology to film and publish footage of the brawl'.

Dvalishvili had been due to fight in a RAF wrestling event on Saturday. CEO and co-founder Chad Bronstein released a statement confirming the fighter is back.

He stated: 'I am pleased to share that Merab Dvalishvili is back with us in Abu Dhabi. We would like to express our sincere appreciation to the relevant authorities in Abu Dhabi for their professionalism and support.

'We remain focused on moving forward and are pleased to have Merab back with us.'.

Nurmagomedov and his team's violent ambush was four months in the making.

Back in July, Dvalishvili was competing in a RAF event in Georgia, which is a freestyle wrestling show the UFC allow their fighters to compete in outside of the day job.

While milling around at the event, a Dagestani wrestler and friend of Umar, Ahmed Gadzhimagomedov, confronted Dvalishvili about refusing to entertain a rematch of any kind with Umar.

UFC star Merab Dvalishvili was attacked in a five-star hotel in Abu Dhabi on Wednesday.

'I was super relaxed, super chilled and then somebody (Gadzhimagomedov) came and grabbed my neck and pulled me over and started yelling at me in Russian language, which I hardly understand,' Dvalishvili told Ariel Helwani.

'And he mentioned Umar. It took me a couple of seconds to realize, "Who is this guy to tell me what to talk about him?".

'It’s between me and Umar… I have so much respect for all Dagestani people, especially fighters. The only guy who I don't like from Dagestan is Umar and his sneaky manager, Rizvan. The guy who was helping Umar disrespect me on X and Threads.'.

After Gadzhimagomedov squared up to him, Dvalishvili shoved him in the neck, shouting: 'What's your problem, b***h!'.

The situation, unlike the hotel brawl that escalated into a complete bloodbath, was swiftly defused and there was a child in close proximity.

Usman wanted to take revenge on behalf of fellow Dagestani Gadzhimagomedov and also his brother Umar, who lost against Dvalishvili in a title shot last year.

In the footage of the hotel attack, the group appeared to approach Dvalishvili, 35, from behind, before one man remarked a couple of words to him and slapped him in the face.

Dvalishvili was rocked, then kicked, and was held back by a man he appeared to be with.

According to recent reports, he tried to fight back but a number of men overwhelmed him as his companion was attacked too. Eventually, the groups were separated, and Dvalishvili took to social media to respond to the incident.

The 35-year-old was blind sided while carrying out an interview.

It has been revealed that he said in a video, bloody and bruised as he received treatment: 'What a sneaky way guys. Just two of us, me and my friend, came here in Abu Dhabi and Usman and his friends came like snakes from behind. What kind of fighters are you guys? What kind of man does this? If you want to fight, let's do it the real way.

In a recent development, 'You guys came when there was two of us, you were prepared. What the f***.'.

His companion then added: 'From behind? You call yourselves men? You're a little b***h.'.

Dvalishvili continued: 'You are sneaky guys. You are not real men. It indicates your guys' character, what the f*** guys? If you want to fight, let's fight. We are fighters. I talk straight, but you guys came from behind. I don't know how many guys, all your friends waiting for us in a sneaky way, wow.

'I knew guys, I knew what kind of guys you were. Usman, Umar and his friends came sneaky from behind, so many guys. Wow. I am fine guys. All my friends and family, I am f***ing fine. I am a fighter. This is nothing for me, but it shows what kind of people you guys are. P***ys do this bro. We are warriors.'.

(ANSA) - BERLINO, 13 NOV - Il Borussia Dortmund non rinnoverà l'accordo di sponsorizzazione con il produttore tedesco di armi Rheinmetall a seguito delle critiche mosse dai tifosi. Lo ha dichiarato il club della Bundesliga, attualmente secondo in campionato. "Siamo consapevoli delle critiche provenienti dai nostri soci e da alcuni settori della nostra tifoseria", ha dichiarato il presidente del consiglio di amministrazione del club, Carsten Cramer, in un comunicato in cui spiegava perché l'accordo, in scadenza nel 2027, non sarebbe stato rinnovato.

Rheinmetall, il più grande produttore tedesco di armi, ha sede a Duesseldorf e produce equipaggiamento militare tra cui carri armati, cannoni e sistemi di difesa aerea, oltre a munizioni e artiglieria navale. (ANSA).

Brutta notizia per il Marsiglia di Bruno Genesio. Emerson Palmieri dovrà infatti fermarsi per diverse settimane dopo essersi sottoposto a un intervento chirurgico al ginocchio sinistro. Il terzino italiano ha anticipato il comunicato del club pubblicando una foto dall'ospedale e rassicurando i tifosi sulle sue condizioni.

Industry observers note that "Un piccolo contrattempo... L'operazione è andata bene e ora è tempo di concentrarmi sul recupero. Starò lontano dai campi per alcune settimane, ma tornerò più forte di prima. Grazie per il vostro sostegno, a presto. Allez l'OM", ha scritto il classe 1994 sui propri profili social. Poco dopo, il Marsiglia ha confermato la notizia spiegando che il difensore si è sottoposto a un'artroscopia al ginocchio sinistro a causa di un dolore ricorrente. L'assenza potrebbe prolungarsi fino alle ultime gare dell'anno oppure fino alla ripresa dopo la sosta invernale.

Industry observers note that L'operazione non era inizialmente prevista. Palmieri aveva accusato fastidio al ginocchio nella sfida vinta contro il Tolosa (2-0) lo scorso 1 novembre, lasciando il campo dopo appena venti minuti per precauzione. Nei giorni successivi le sensazioni sembravano positive, ma il problema lo aveva comunque costretto a saltare le partite contro il Bayer Leverkusen in Europa League e contro il Lens. Il terzino italiano è stato titolare nelle prime otto giornate di campionato e rappresenta un elemento importante per il tecnico Genesio. La scelta di intervenire chirurgicamente nasce dalla volontà condivisa tra giocatore e staff medico di risolvere definitivamente il problema e permettere a Palmieri di tornare protagonista nel 2027.

💡 Key Takeaways
  • Industry observers note that never mind the lack of an ice vest, George Russell is somehow going to need to be the coolest man in Malaysia if he is to turn seventh on the grid into a positive result in Sunday’s Bahrain Grand Prix.The first race in Sepang in nearly a decade – a late addition to the calendar because of the conflict in the Middle East – promises to be an absolute scorcher.
  • Industry observers note that it will be the first time since Hungary 2023 that those two gladiators have started on a front row together.
  • It has been revealed that russell might need something wacky if he is to do anything from that far back.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Industry observers note that never mind the lack of an ice vest, George Russell is somehow going to need to be the coolest man in Malaysia if he is to turn seventh on the grid into a positive result in Sunday’s Bahrain Grand Prix.The first race in Sepang in nearly a decade – a late addition to the calendar because of the conflict in the Middle East – promises to be an absolute scorcher. It might even be worth setting your alarm for the 8am UK start time. Red Bull’s Max Verstappen will start in pole position for the first time this year. He will have Ferrari’s Lewis Hamilton alongside him.

Industry observers note that it will be the first time since Hungary 2023 that those two gladiators have started on a front row together. Throw in sweltering temperatures, low grip, high tyre degradation, and the ever-present threat of a Malaysian monsoon sweeping through Sepang, and you have the potential for fireworks.

It has been revealed that russell might need something wacky if he is to do anything from that far back. This was a desperately disappointing result for the British driver. After his victory in Baku last weekend, Russell was hopeful he had finally found the winning formula and that he could continue to take the fight to his team-mate Kimi Antonelli, whom he trails in the drivers’ championship by 66pts.

Industry observers note that eighth, four places behind, and 0.24sec slower than the Italian, was not what Russell would have had in mind, although both Mercedes drivers will rise a spot because of the five-place grid penalty meted out to Red Bull’s Isack Hadjar for exceeding his engine allowance for the season.Russell will have felt particularly disappointed as Antonelli only got one run in Q3 after using up a set of soft tyres when he made a mistake and went off track in Q2. He now trails his team mate nine-seven in qualifying head-to-head this year.“No to be honest,” Russell admitted when asked whether he knew why he was so slow. “This circuit is an outlier in terms of the abrasiveness of the tarmac.“The lap times seven years ago were six or seven seconds faster and at certain points on the track it feels like you are driving on gravel, which is the same for everyone, but it is clearly affecting us more than others.”Mercedes’ lack of performance was doubly unexpected because not only did they arrive here with a massive upgrade package, but Russell revealed this week that he and Antonelli were foregoing the cooling vests you see some drivers sporting on the grid, in favour of car performance.

Toto Wolff, the Mercedes team principal, admitted it was a head-scratcher. “Very difficult to understand,” the Austrian noted. “We have been a little bit caught out on Friday with some car behaviour that we did not see all year, but then you can say it is very hot and the tarmac is different to all the [other] tracks. It looked really good this morning. We seemed to have, at least with Kimi, made a step in understanding. And then, qualifying was a little bit back to what we saw before, just no performance.”.

It has been revealed that still, both titles are in the bag so Wolff cannot be too unhappy. Russell is the one who will be really miffed. He really needs to be beating his team-mate pretty much every race weekend if he is to get his title hopes back on track.

At the front, the mood was somewhat different. Verstappen became the first non-Mercedes-powered pilot to take a pole position this year. It was a first pole position for Red Bull Powertrains, too. And with his long run pace looking more than decent, Verstappen should really hold on for his first win of 2026. Hamilton will do his best to hang on to the Dutchman’s coattails. The seven-time champion was delighted when told he had taken P2. “Let’s go guys! Finally! Great job guys, really great job. Car felt great.”.

Industry observers note that this was indeed an excellent performance from the Ferrari man – and just the tonic for the Scuderia after weeks of gossip and speculation. Hamilton was admittedly three tenths slower than his rival, which he put purely down to a power deficit on the straights, but he said he was hopeful his long run pace was more competitive. The last time a F1 held a race was held here back in 2017, the British driver claimed pole only to be overhauled by a youthful Verstappen. He will be desperate to turn the tables this time.

It has been revealed that “It was really hard to find a good balance, and we made one change before qualifying and we hit the sweet spot,” he reflected afterwards. “I am so, so grateful. I will try my best to hold on to Max tomorrow, and if we are in the fight that would be awesome. I’ve been talking too much, but I guess you talk more when you are happy. It was my best lap of the year. It feels like I won, and I will give it everything tomorrow.”.

Industry observers note that it is Russell, though, who needs a result even more badly if he is to remain a factor in the championship. “As a team, we have yet to have a bad race this whole season and this was clearly a very bad qualifying for us,” he admitted, adding that “all the numbers” from the upgrade package suggested it was an improvement on the old car. “But I think there is going to be a lot happening tomorrow. The tyre deg is huge and race pace will be king. So even though today was a real disappointment it is not the be all and end all.”.

According to recent reports, no. 1 ☝️#F1 #BahrainGP pic.twitter.com/01PqrckQS9.

Tomorrow’s race will be the first time since Hungary 2023 that Max Verstappen and Lewis Hamilton will start on the front row together. It is a reasonable run down to turn one and there are overtaking opportunities through the first few corners at Sepang, with it being similar to the configuration in China, with plenty of lines and moves on offer.

Respect between two great champions 🤩#F1 #BahrainGP pic.twitter.com/fbZ6aoKRyw.

“Very difficult to understand. We have been a little bit caught out on Friday with some car behaviour that we did not see all year, but then you can say it is very hot and the tarmac is the different to all the (other) tracks. It looked really good this morning. We seemed to have, at least with Kimi [Antonelli], made a step in understanding. And then, qualifying was a little bit back to what we saw before, just no performance.”.

On Kimi Antonelli’s track limits breach in Q2:.

In a recent development, “Not good, because Q2 you know you are going to get through. You lose a set [of softs] in a qualifying that is so tight, where we are on the back foot. That is not good.”.

Lewis Hamilton indicates this is the biggest crowd he has ever seen at Sepang, thanking the fans for making it here today. That is actually a bigger compliment than many watching at home may realise. The traffic this weekend has been horrendous. After 10 years without a race in Malaysia, during which time F1 has grown massively, I think they have forgotten how to do traffic management. Shuttles are inconsistent, taxis can’t get in/out, it’s taking forever just to reach the airport a few kilometres away - some fans have been braving the heat and walking. It took over two hours to get back into Kuala Lumpur last night (48km). My understanding is the Bahrainis are organising the race this year, while local forces are handling the traffic outside the circuit.

Industry observers note that “The car has been very good since last week. It is good to come back [from his wrist injury] at such a time and I am enjoying it, fighting for the top three. Even though it was not my finest qualifying session it is a good feeling.

“It is a bit unfortunate we take a penalty on a track where we are that fast but, from eighth, I am confident we can come through the field and come back for a good result.”.

Sources indicate that “I love this energy [from the crowd]. Big, big thank you to Malaysia for welcoming us. It is so hot here. I keep saying it, but that has made it a massive challenge for the tyres, the car, the mechanics in the garage. I am really, really thankful to my team. We made so many changes through all these practice sessions. Because the cars are sliding, the tyres are overheating, it was really hard to find a good balance, and we made one last change going into qualifying and I think we hit the sweet spot. To be able to close the gap to two or three tenths to Max [Verstappen], who has been so quick all weekend, is great, and I am so grateful.

According to recent reports, “I am much happier with where the car is, but tomorrow is a completely different ballgame. Making these tyres last around this track, they are overheating from the get-go. Every little bit of wheelspin you have, every little snap you have makes a difference of how far you are going to go. I like to think we have got a good balance. Max was really quick on his long runs, so I will just try my best to hold onto him tomorrow.”.

A reminder that Isack Hadjar will drop from third to eighth after his grid penalty.

Sometimes a bit closer than others but to finally get it, from where we started the season, pretty incredible. I am happy with today and, for sure, I am going to try and win tomorrow. When you start first, that is the target.”.

Big disappointment that for Russell. After his win in Baku, where he said he finally felt hooked up to the car, he was desperate to build the momentum. P8, four places behind Antonelli, was not what he would have had in mind. Has it all to do in the race tomorrow.

Excellent (though not unexpected) pole for Verstappen, and a very good P2 for Hamilton. Could be some fireworks on the front row tomorrow.

That means that Verstappen takes pole in Malaysia, which is the first time this season that Red Bull have taken pole position. Hamilton is second with Hadjar third, although the Frenchman has a five-place grid penalty.

Lindblad, who's taking a grid penalty for Sunday's race, gave team mate Lawson a tow but it wasn't quite enough to send the Kiwi into Q3#F1 #BahrainGP pic.twitter.com/IMlrqg4ENv.

In a recent development, as the young Italian starts his flying lap, there is no-one else out on track so no traffic. He is a lot more cautious at turn six this time than last time, when he had his lap time deleted.

He has not set blistering first and second sector times but a purple final sector puts him into second and the Italian is safely into Q3.

Plenty of other drivers are now heading around the track for their final flying laps of Q2.

11. Lance Stroll (Aston Martin)12. Carlos Sainz (Williams)13. Kimi Antonelli (Mercedes)14. Arvid Lindblad (Racing Bulls)15. Franco Colapinto (Alpine)16. Fernando Alonso (Aston Martin).

Industry observers note that mercedes have put a brand new set of softs onto Antonelli’s car as he heads out promptly, with no lap time to his name so far. Antonelli is still disputing the lap deletion over team radio but his team tell him the images show he exceeded track limits. This is now a lot of pressure on the championship leader; any mistake now and he will not make Q3. His teammate Russell is only in seventh.

According to recent reports, antonelli was fourth fastest but has had his lap time deleted for exceeding track limits at turn six. That is a significant moment in Q2 and could prove problematic if he gets into Q3. Antonelli appeared to be confused when he was told about his lap deletion over team radio but the on-board view looked pretty clear-cut.

Piastri then comes across the line in third.

Here's the moment Kimi ran wide 👀#F1 #BahrainGP pic.twitter.com/E0VdWdBt8x.

Industry observers note that the Dutchman looks in a great spot at the moment to take pole position today and his 1:35.696 is very quick. He is nearly four tenths quicker than Antonelli.

How about the Ferraris? Leclerc was quickest in the middle sector but is nearly three tenths down on Verstappen. Hamilton puts himself into third place. Russell is more than half a second down on Verstappen.

Sources indicate that verstappen has been shown a black and white flag for driving unnecessarily slowly. I doubt he will get a grid penalty for that but it will be a warning for the Dutchman.

Anyway, the drivers, other than Colapinto and Alonso, are on flying laps, with Verstappen currently fastest inthe first sector.

The green light is showing at the end of the pit lane and the second part of qualifying is under way. Like the start of Q1, it is hardly a stampede to go out.

Industry observers note that 17. Nico Hulkenberg (Audi)18. Oliver Bearman (Haas)19. Esteban Ocon (Haas)20. Alex Albon (Williams)21. Valtteri Bottas (Cadillac)22. Sergio Perez (Cadillac).

The Aston Martin of Stroll improves significantly from 20th and is set to make Q2, as is his teammate Alonso. A bit of a surprise to see the Aston Martins improve and make it into Q2.

Go Fernando! 🤩 Go Lance! 🤩First double Q2 appearance this season 🙌#F1 #BahrainGP pic.twitter.com/xjiWYv6ycr.

That has seen the Audi of Hulkenberg drop into the drop zone and the German is out. For contrast, his teammate improves to go into eighth place! Hulkenberg had a big lock up into turn 14, which proved very costly.

Industry observers note that as it stands, eight of the top nine are remaining in the garage. Russell is in ninth and has not gone out but Gasly above him in eighth has. You would imagine Russell is perfectly safe.

Recent findings suggest that 17. Esteban Ocon (Haas)18. Alex Albon (Williams)19. Oliver Bearman (Haas)20. Lance Stroll (Aston Martin)21. Valtteri Bottas (Cadillac)22. Sergio Perez (Cadillac).

Ocon, in 17th, is quite far off Hulkenberg in 16th and needs more than four tenths to usurp him.

Recent findings suggest that the screens in the media centre here in Sepang tell me that the air temp right now is 32.8C and the track temp is 58C. It feels even hotter. Lots of chat about cooling vests this week, which are optional. George Russell is among the drivers who isn’t using one, which is interesting a) because Russell has suffered badly from heat in the past (Qatar, Singapore) and b) because he claims Mercedes chose to put the development money into car upgrades instead.

According to recent reports, it’s an interesting admission. Not everyone is sold on the idea of cooling vests. Ferrari and McLaren will definitely be using them this weekend, for instance. Max Verstappen won’t as he doesn’t like them. Russell thinks the FIA should just develop the tech themselves and it shouldn’t be part of the budget cap.

It has been revealed that “Our team have put a lot of emphasis this year on the cockpit temperature,” he stated. “We won’t be running the cooling vest because we haven’t put the resource into making it robust enough. I feel we need the FIA just to step in and say ‘Here’s some money extra in the cost cap or there’s an external company who’s going to develop it for everybody’. Because we should all be wearing it. When it works, it works great. So, I would like to wear it this week, and I would like to wear it next week. But the team asked me...look, we can develop it, and we can put the money towards it...[but at a cost].

He added: “The top itself is not expensive ..you’ve got to effectively make a system where you can fit a block of dry ice or actual ice, and then has the airflow to circulate the cool water throughout. If that system isn’t robust enough, then suddenly you have no circulation, and then you get hot. You get ambient temperature circulating. The vest is one-design, but the system that circulates the water is different [at different teams].”.

The two Ferraris are on medium tyres but Leclerc still puts himself into second place. He is then displaced by Hamilton, who slots in behind Verstappen. Good times from the Ferraris on the mediums.

Sources indicate that what about the McLarens? Norris goes sixth fastest but is more than six tenths down on Verstappen. Then comes Piastri, who goes fourth fastest, just under four tenths off Verstappen.

Arguably the three favourites for pole; Antonelli, Russell and Verstappen, are all on flying laps.

The first sector goes the way of Verstappen, who is purple, and then the Dutchman goes purple in the middle sector.

In a recent development, antonelli is two tenths faster than his teammate Russell but Verstappen is over half a second quicker than the Mercedes. Hadjar is then second fastest to show the pace in the Red Bull this weekend.

Most of the teams waited and waited to come out and then suddenly lots of drivers are sent out, resulting in a queue in the pits! With the high track temperatures and high degradation, the drivers are crawling around on their out laps to preserve these soft tyres.

Sources indicate that bumper to bumper in the pit lane! #F1 #BahrainGP pic.twitter.com/ff8JO9kB1g.

It has been revealed that the two Haas drivers have a free track to themselves whilst everyone else bides their time. In theory, as the hour of qualifying goes on, the track temperature should decrease and the more rubber that is laid down the faster the track should get.

Finally, just before the two Haas drivers finish their first flying laps, the rest of the grid is starting to emerge, led by the Mercedes duo.

Recent findings suggest that the green light is showing at the end of the pit lane and Q1 is officially under way. The two Haas drivers are the first to head out. Other than that, it is a quiet start to Q1.

According to recent reports, the top four teams; Mercedes, Red Bull, Ferrari and McLaren, all have a genuine chance of taking pole in Sepang today. I think the true favourites though have to be the Mercedes duo and Max Verstappen but with how close it between all four of the teams you cannot rule anything out.

It is 33 degrees celsius air temperature, with the track temperature up at 58 degrees.

Not long to wait now until qualifying begins. It is hot, humid and dry in Sepang right now. As we know in Malaysia, the weather can change quickly and thunderstorms can roll in quite quickly but it looks like today’s qualifying will be a dry one. This will be one of if not the hottest qualifying sessions of the season, so much so that we are seeing umbrellas going up to get some shade from the sun rather than sheltering from any rain.

This will be crucial to consider after qualifying finishes as there will be some shuffling around:.

Isack Hadjar (Red Bull): five-place grid penalty- newly introduced internal combustion engineFranco Colapinto (Alpine): ten-place grid penalty- new engineFranco Colapinto (Alpine): five-place grid penalty- causing a collision in BakuArvid Lindblad (Racing Bulls): back of the grid- complete power unit change.

Hadjar has looked good since returning from his wrist injury so could be fighting it out near the front of the grid, although his five-place penalty will drop him down. We know Lindblad will be at the back and is very likely to be joined there by Colapinto, who is not going to be qualifying high up in the top ten in his Alpine.

Haas have revealed that Frenchman Esteban Ocon will leave at the end of this season. Ocon now faces an uncertain future, with it difficult to see a spot for him on the F1 grid next season. There are suggestions that the 30-year-old’s replacement will be Brazilian Ferrari junior Rafael Camara, although nothing has been confirmed on that front. 21-year-old Camara presently leads the Formula 2 championship.

TGR Haas F1 Team and Esteban Ocon will part ways at the conclusion of the 2026 season. With plenty of racing ahead, our focus remains on working together to maximize every opportunity through to the final race of the year.#HaasF1 #F1 pic.twitter.com/4iQAuqnSyA.

Aston Martin have now confirmed their driver line-up for next season, retaining both Fernando Alonso and Lance Stroll. There had been reports that Alonso had been contemplating retirement but the 45-year-old will continue into another season.

Aston Martin Aramco confirms Lance and Fernando will continue as the team's drivers in 2027. Read more: ​https://t.co/ePyjJdyAIB pic.twitter.com/VogFUEbNxy.

Other than the second seat alongside Ollie Bearman at Haas, the only other team to keep an eye on is Racing Bulls, with no definite confirmation on their exact driver line-up for next season.

Ferrari this week have publicly backed their team principal Frederic Vasseur, amid speculation over the Frenchman’s position and comments made by former Red Bull team principal Christian Horner, who said the job at Ferrari would be a “dream job”. Ferrari, who sit second in the constructors’ standings, have not won the drivers’ championship since 2007 (Kimi Raikkonen) and the constructors’ since 2008. Here is a snippet from Tom Cary’s piece on the matter:.

In a hastily convened media call on Tuesday morning, Maria Conti, Ferrari’s chief communication officer, said the Scuderia had decided to issue a vote of confidence in Vasseur in response “not just to the story of Mr Horner, but in general, the speculation about Fred”.

Industry observers note that “Ferrari has made its choices,” Conti mentioned. “We have confidence – full confidence – in Fred Vasseur and in his team, and we continue to do so.

“At this time, it’s really crucial that the team remains united and cohesive, and we are focused with all the energy on the work ahead.”.

In a recent development, “It is great to be back [in Malaysia]. I am really enjoying the track. We have had some wonderful races here over time. It is actually the 20th time we have been here, it started in 1999, and it is really exciting to be back. I really enjoyed getting out on the track and watching the cars closely.

It has been revealed that “The drivers are super fit and they have some cooling but it is not easy. But you almost cannot get enough fluid through your body before your stomach gives up. Having this race and Singapore back-to-back increases that challenge.”.

Especially with the big upgrade they have brought this weekend, Mercedes’ lead at the summit is looking unassailable right now.

In a recent development, almost nine years ago to the day, Max Verstappen took just his second race victory in Formula 1. Lewis Hamilton, who took pole position, and Daniel Ricciardo joined Verstappen on the podium. Despite being nine years ago, plenty of drivers still on the grid were racing that weekend. Here they are and who they were racing for:.

Max Verstappen (Red Bull) Lewis Hamilton (Mercedes) Valtteri Bottas (Mercedes) Esteban Ocon (Force India)Nico Hulkenberg (Renault)Sergio Perez (Force India)Fernando Alonso (McLaren)Lance Stroll (Williams)Carlos Sainz (Toro Rosso)Pierre Gasly (Toro Rosso).

With Russell winning in Baku and Antonelli finishing fifth, the latter’s championship lead was cut to 66 points. If Russell is going to usurp his teammate, he is going to need a few more similar results to last weekend due to the size of Antonelli’s lead. If Antonelli were to suffer a retirement, then that completely changes the outlook.

It has been revealed that formula One returns to Malaysia for round 16 of the season for the Bahrain Grand Prix. That probably sounds strange but after the Bahrain Grand Prix was originally postponed in March, F1 reinstated it to the calendar with Malaysia hosting it because of the ongoing war in the Middle East. Despite being held in Malaysia, Bahrain have retained the naming rights for the event, which is officially known as the Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia. The last time Formula One was in Malaysia was nine years ago back in 2017, when a young whippersnapper named Max Verstappen, still four years away from winning his first world championship, claimed just his second victory.

Industry observers note that last time out around the streets of Baku, Mercedes’ George Russell claimed victory at the Azerbaijan Grand Prix, pipping Verstappen by just a tenth of a second. That was Russell’s first grand prix win since June and cuts his team-mate Kimi Antonelli’s lead in the drivers’ standings to 66 points. Antonelli had a challenging weekend in Baku, starting 16th after a crash in qualifying and coming home in fifth to see his championship lead to Russell cut by 15 points.

Verstappen was quickest in first practice yesterday, with the Ferrari of Charles Leclerc fastest in second practice. Earlier today, championship leader Antonelli was nearly three tenths clear of the field in third practice. Mercedes, 160 points clear at the top of the constructors’ standings, have brought significant upgrades this weekend, which includes a fresh floor, rear suspension and rear corner. It is the team’s first significant car update since the Canadian Grand at the end of May.

This race in Malaysia represents the second leg of the season’s first flyaway triple header, with the Singapore Grand Prix to come next weekend, so the demands on the teams and the drivers are incredibly high. Qualifying from Sepang gets under way at 9am (GMT).

It has been revealed that arrivano notizie incoraggianti dalla Polonia sulle condizioni di Piotr Zielinski. Il centrocampista dell'Inter, costretto a saltare la sfida di Nations League contro la Romania a causa di un problema al piede, è pronto a tornare ad allenarsi regolarmente con il resto della Nazionale.

A fare il punto della situazione è stato il commissario tecnico Jan Urban, intervenuto in conferenza stampa alla vigilia della partita contro la Svezia, in programma martedì 17 novembre.

According to recent reports, LE PAROLE DI URBAN – "Piotr Zielinski ha problemi al piede, ma oggi si allenerà normalmente. Ieri ha partecipato alla prima parte dell'allenamento, poi ha lavorato individualmente. Dopo l'allenamento di oggi sapremo se sarà pronto per la partita di domani".

It has been revealed that zielinski aveva accusato un problema alla pianta del piede che gli aveva impedito di scendere in campo contro la Romania. Domenica aveva partecipato soltanto alla prima parte dell'allenamento collettivo, proseguendo poi con un lavoro individuale.

Il ritorno alla normale attività con il gruppo rappresenterebbe un passo avanti importante, anche se resta da verificare la risposta del giocatore ai carichi di lavoro.

Soltanto dopo l'allenamento odierno lo staff medico e tecnico della Polonia stabilirà se Zielinski potrà essere utilizzato nella gara contro la Svezia.

  • It has been revealed that L'Inter si conferma sempre, oggi un altro oro da aggiungere ai trofei dell'anno scorso, la Panchina d'Oro di Chivu.
